question: Should this base PR carry the runtime `@openclaw/design-system` dependency before the stacked palette PR imports it?
rationale: The safe repair depends on the intended stack shape: moving the dependency, adding a real consumer, or allowing a temporary dead-code exception are different maintainer-owned tradeoffs.

options.title: Move Dependency To First Consumer
options.body: Keep this base focused on vendored design skills and put the runtime package dependency in the palette PR or whichever branch first imports it.

options.title: Consume It In This Base
options.body: Add the minimal stylesheet/import usage here so the package is no longer a dead dependency and the base can pass static checks standalone.

options.title: Allow A Temporary Exception
options.body: Keep the dependency in this base only with an explicit Knip exception and a clear follow-up plan for the stacked consumer PR.

recommendation.title: Move Dependency To First Consumer
recommendation.body: Keep this base focused on vendored design skills and put the runtime package dependency in the palette PR or whichever branch first imports it.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current design-system install stack and recent skill-lock/package workflow history.
